import os
from pathlib import Path


def test_steady():
    assert True


def test_alternates():
    p = Path(os.environ["SUITE_AUDIT_COUNTER"])
    n = int(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else 0
    p.write_text(str(n + 1))
    assert n % 2 == 0


def test_needs_an_untracked_file():
    assert (Path(__file__).parent / "local.txt").exists()
